user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the multi-level navigation menu so that I can access different sections of the application easily. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click on 'Main Item 1', the menu should not change the URL. 
2. When I click on 'Sub Item', I should be able to see 'Sub Sub List »' as a nested option. 
3. Clicking on 'Sub Sub Item 1' should take me to the same URL without changing it, but I should see the corresponding content.
